score_reasons.quality: High production value: the red silk has convincing sheen, translucency and fold physics; the woman's face and embroidered costume are sharply detailed; clean edges throughout. Minor deductions for the slightly muddy, crowded small structures along the bottom edge and some softness in the distant miniature buildings.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Excellent composition: the S-shaped silk ribbon drives the eye from bottom-right to upper-left, balancing the vertical typography on the left; restrained red/white palette with teal-blue costume accents; bright, airy guochao mood; the figure's pose is graceful and anatomically sound.
score_reasons.alignment: Most requirements are met: white textured background, S-curve red silk from lower-right to upper-left, woman in Beijing-flavored traditional costume waving silk, silk morphing into a city scroll with recognizable Temple of Heaven, Great Wall, Bird's Nest lattice structure and red autumn forest; SPRING 2026, vertical Beijing, and the red seal 北京 are all present and clean. Misses: canvas is 1:1 rather than the required 9:16 vertical; 什刹海 is not clearly identifiable; 京味相声 (crosstalk) element is not visible anywhere.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Landmarks hold up to reality checks: Temple of Heaven's triple-eaved circular form, the Great Wall's winding ridge with towers, and the Bird's Nest steel lattice are all credible; costume and headdress plausibly evoke Beijing opera/court styling; text is accurate; no offensive or non-compliant content.
score_reasons.creative_generation: The silk-to-cityscape morph is executed seamlessly, with buildings dissolving into fabric folds; strong information hierarchy (title block, seal, figure, scroll); good lens language with the diagonal ribbon creating depth. Slight deduction because the lower-strip collage feels less integrated than the upper scroll.

unfulfilled_requirements: Aspect ratio is 1:1, not the required 9:16 vertical
什刹海 (Shichahai) scene not clearly identifiable in the city scroll
京味相声 (Beijing crosstalk) cultural element not depicted
transcribed_text: Beijing (vertical stacked sans-serif letters on left edge, spelled correctly)
北京 (white characters in small red seal stamp below Beijing, correct)
